purpose: Validate the A/B measurement pipeline and observe whether process placement creates opposing normal-path and fault-path effects before the final campaign.

target.power_condition: AC or battery level recorded in manifest
target.background_condition: ordinary desktop idle; observed process list is not modified by the harness

fixed_context.agent_state: persistent file outside the VIA integration-client fault domain for recovery trials
fixed_context.s2s_model: not on the DP-11 integration-client fault path; no synthetic S2S delay is inserted
fixed_context.semantic_llm: not on the DP-11 integration-client fault path; no synthetic model delay is inserted
fixed_context.model_replication: exactly one S2S and one semantic LLM in the system; neither is instantiated by this harness

A.description: Agent client code runs in a supervised child process; Core communicates through versioned JSON-lines IPC.

B.description: The same Agent client code runs inside the Core process behind an async bridge.

normal_bridge_diagnostic.reason: The bridge subspan does not contain the user/acoustic endpoints required by QA-01, QA-03, or QA-05.

integration_client_fatal_recovery.fault: the VIA-owned Agent client process/address space aborts after 1 or 4 running Tasks have durable execution links
integration_client_fatal_recovery.success_oracle: all affected Task/run links remain correct, the external execution is queryable, and valid Task control is usable
integration_client_fatal_recovery.pilot_metric: maximum of the two stratum p95 full recovery times

integration_client_fatal_blast_radius.fault: the same VIA-owned Agent client address space aborts
integration_client_fatal_blast_radius.metric: maximum count of independent units made unavailable by the fault

observability.metric: 100 * records containing every required field / all scored raw records

aggregation.failures: retained in the denominator and raw data; a timeout uses the frozen timeout as a censored lower bound and fails its oracle
aggregation.candidate_order: normal diagnostic same_process then isolated_worker; recovery and blast commands exercise both candidates in a fixed implementation order recorded in raw data
aggregation.selection: no winner is selected by the pilot

limitations: QA-31 covers one frozen integration-client-fatal fault stratum, not the final all-fault maximum.
The normal bridge timings are supporting diagnostics and must not be reported as QA-01, QA-03, or QA-05.
QA-32 applies only to the frozen independent-unit registry in this contract.
The QA-61 pilot result validates the external evidence envelope; it does not yet validate preservation of worker-local log records immediately before a fatal abort.
